description: Fires when the center column (3) holds exactly four stones and the top one (row 4 from the bottom) is the opponent's, so my next center drop lands on the fifth row. It is strongest when the opponent also owns the stone(s) just below (a vertical two or three ending at that cell) and when they just played it, and in earlier positions; weak late in the game. Never fires for other columns or other center heights.
effect: Small and inconsistent: forcing it high or off moves column probabilities by a few points (up to ~17 in one case) with no consistent column direction; roughly none measurable.
notes: Base rule (center height 4, top theirs) has recall 0.96 but precision 0.53. Adding '(stone below also theirs) or last move in col 3 or ply<=14' gives dev F1 0.777 (P .685 R .897, AUROC .942), sim share 1.04. A point system reached F1 0.781. Minimal pairs: height 3 or 5 -> no fire; same stacks in cols 2/4 -> no fire; top stone mine -> no fire. Unexplained variance: stones in column 4 suppress in act tests but that does not generalize on dev. Synthesis peaks at 9.16, under the 9.55 dev max.
